"""Finite telemetry adapter for AST projection, evidence mining and decoding.

The module adapts the JSON job of the telemetry rule compiler protocol to the
NetNomos AST, compiles every predicate into a vectorised evaluator and then runs
the exact finite pipeline:

1. mixed-radix enumeration of the declared Cartesian window universe,
2. exhaustive discovery of every inclusion-minimal clause of length at most
   ``width`` that holds on all training windows and is falsified somewhere in
   the universe, together with its deterministic witnesses/counterexample,
3. restriction of the theory to the operator-approved discovered clauses,
4. exact decoding of every query over the joint approved theory.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import itertools

    DatasetSpec,
